news.title: Fatal shooting investigation underway in Atlanta
news.summary: Atlanta police are investigating a fatal shooting in southwest Atlanta.

news.title: Police investigating deadly shooting in southwest Atlanta, APD says
news.summary: An investigation is underway following a deadly shooting on Head Rd SW on Tuesday evening, according to the Atlanta Police Department.

news.title: Violent robbery suspect crashes stolen Atlanta police cruiser on I-675
news.summary: A man accused of attacking a woman at the Midtown MARTA station later stole an Atlanta police cruiser and crashed it into a tanker truck on I-675, according to police.

news.title: Midtown beating victim calls alleged attacker who stole cop car a 'menace'
news.summary: A Midtown assault victim called her attacker a "menace to society" after finding a chilling threat on her stolen phone from the suspect who later stole and crashed an Atlanta police cruiser.

news.title: Mableton appoints city's first police chief
news.summary: The City of Mableton appointed its first chief of police during a special-called city council meeting Tuesday night.

news.title: Couple convicted after fake homeless nonprofit took grant money
news.summary: A federal jury has convicted a couple of fraud in a scheme that prosecutors say took $529,500 in federal grant money from Gwinnett County, one of four local governments that paid their nonprofit.

news.title: 3 years after metro Atlanta photographer’s killing, family finally gets answers
news.summary: More than three years after someone shot and killed a well- known photographer, his family is finally getting answers about what happened the night of the shooting.

news.title: Federal agents arrest 20 in Georgia gun, drug trafficking investigation
news.summary: Federal prosecutors charged 20 Atlanta residents with federal gun and drug crimes after thieves stole nearly 1,500 firearms from shipping facilities in Conley and Macon.

news.title: Coweta County DA provides update after Newnan officer shoots, kills 18-year-old
news.summary: Coweta County District Attorney said his office reached out to the teen's family to offer a direct meeting to explain the legal process and review evidence.

news.title: Atlanta spa shooter death penalty case has status hearing, lawyers will return in three months
news.summary: Defense attorneys for Robert Aaron Long said Tuesday they were still reviewing material in the 5 1/2-year-old case.

news.title: 'I'll shoot y'all and everyone else' | Warrants allege confrontation, threats before Midtown assault suspect stole police cruiser
news.summary: Phelan Thorpe, 31, faces numerous charges after a Midtown assault and robbery was captured on cameras and then he allegedly stole a police vehicle and crashed it.

news.title: How a bow tie, shoes linked a Missouri man to a Georgia Lululemon break-in
news.summary: Peachtree City police have filed criminal charges against a Missouri man after connecting him to a July break-in at a local Lululemon store.

news.title: Feds indict 20 people, including 5 from 'GoodFellas' gang, for drug, gun trafficking ring
news.summary: GoodFellas criminal street gang is an Atlanta-based crime syndicate that recruits its members from neighborhoods throughout Atlanta and prisons throughout Georgia.

news.title: Police: Sisters posing as animal advocates kept dozens of animals in horrific conditions
news.summary: Two sisters were arrested in Fulton County facing 19 counts of animal cruelty after dozens of pets were found neglected.

news.title: Second arrest made in Vine City shooting that killed former football player
news.summary: Chance Blue faces murder, robbery, and assault charges in a targeted shooting that killed former Georgia State athlete Demazio Skelton Jr.

news.title: Man shot multiple times at northwest Atlanta gas station
news.summary: Officers responded to a report of a person shot at a northwest Atlanta gas station Tuesday morning, where they found a man inside a gas station with multiple gunshot wounds.

news.title: 71-year-old man convicted of sex crimes against child under 10, DA says
news.summary: A 71-year-old man faces sentencing after a Cherokee County jury convicted him of sexually abusing a child under 10 years old, according to the district attorney's office.

news.title: DA asks to expedite autopsy in Newnan police shooting
news.summary: The Coweta Judicial Circuit District Attorney is pushing for expedited forensic testing following the fatal officer-involved shooting of an 18-year-old man in Newnan.

news.title: Search underway for stolen tuxedo kitten in Marietta
news.summary: A search is underway for a 5-and-a-half-month-old kitten stolen from a Marietta pet store adoption site, according to animal rescue officials.

news.title: Medical emergency at Cobb jail ends in detainee's death
news.summary: A 42-year-old man held at the Cobb County Adult Detention Center died early Tuesday morning after experiencing a medical emergency in his cell, authorities said.

news.title: I-85 chase ends with PIT maneuver, North Carolina man arrested
news.summary: A North Carolina man was arrested Oct. 2 after authorities say he drove toward officers in the emergency lane of Interstate 85.
